import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import counters
cancelled = [{'kind': 'case_created', 'body': {}}, {'kind': 'case_cancelled', 'body': {}}]
complete = [{'kind': 'case_created', 'body': {}}, {'kind': 'effect_succeeded', 'body': {'action': 'accept_change'}}]
other = [{'kind': 'case_created', 'body': {}}, {'kind': 'effect_succeeded', 'body': {'action': 'push_branch'}}]
fresh = [{'kind': 'case_created', 'body': {}}]
got = counters.cases_open({'a': cancelled, 'b': complete, 'c': other, 'd': fresh})
assert got == 2, 'cases_open: a case is open when it is neither cancelled (a case_cancelled event) nor complete (its acceptance clause passed: an effect_succeeded for the action accept_change); of a cancelled, a complete, one with another effect and a fresh case, 2 are open; got %r' % got

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import counters
def ev(kind, pid, **body):
    return {'kind': kind, 'body': {'proposal_id': pid, **body}}
events = [ev('effect_started', 'p1'), ev('effect_succeeded', 'p1'),
          ev('effect_started', 'p2'), ev('effect_rejected', 'p2'),
          ev('effect_started', 'p3'), ev('reconciled', 'p3', success=True, proof={'verified': True, 'external_id': 'x', 'response_digest': 'd'}),
          ev('effect_started', 'p4'), ev('reconciled', 'p4', success=True, proof={'verified': False}),
          ev('effect_started', 'p5')]
got = counters.effects(events)
expected = {'effects_settled_applied_total': 2, 'effects_settled_not_applied_total': 1, 'effects_pending': 2}
assert got == expected, 'effects: every claimed effect (effect_started) is in exactly one of applied (effect_succeeded, or a reconciled whose success is true and whose proof is verified with an external_id and a response_digest), not applied (effect_rejected) or pending (everything else, including an unverified reconciliation); expected %r, got %r' % (expected, got)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import reading
doc = {'key': 'cases_open', 'value': 3, 'observed_at': 1.0, 'version': 'abc123'}
got = reading.headers(doc)
assert got.get('ETag') == '"abc123"', 'etag: the ETag is the version in double quotes, a strong validator, so an intervention that prefers the ETag header records the quoted form; got %r' % got.get('ETag')
assert got.get('X-Record-Version') == 'abc123', 'etag: the version is also sent unquoted as X-Record-Version; got %r' % got.get('X-Record-Version')
assert got.get('Cache-Control') == 'no-store' and got.get('Content-Type') == 'application/json', 'etag: Content-Type application/json and Cache-Control no-store stay; got %r' % got

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import rows
got = rows.response(rows.Refused('thread_incomplete', 'start was interrupted'))
assert got == (409, {'error': 'thread_incomplete', 'detail': 'start was interrupted'}), 'refusal_status: a refusal is answered with its code and detail as {error, detail}, status 409; got %r' % (got,)
got = rows.response(rows.Refused('unknown_thread', 'zzz'))
assert got == (404, {'error': 'unknown_thread', 'detail': 'zzz'}), 'refusal_status: a refusal whose code starts with unknown is 404; got %r' % (got,)
got = rows.response(ValueError('boom'))
assert got == (500, {'error': 'internal_error'}), 'refusal_status: any other exception is 500 {error: internal_error} with no detail; got %r' % (got,)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import reading
import hashlib, json
got = reading.version('cases_open', 3, 1792651912.25)
expected = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({'key': 'cases_open', 'value': 3, 'observed_at': 1792651912.25}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
assert got == expected, 'version: the version is the full SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators "," and ":", non-ASCII unescaped) of {key, value, observed_at}, so a repeated read of the same value carries a new version; expected %r, got %r' % (expected, got)
assert reading.version('cases_open', 3, 1792651912.25) != reading.version('cases_open', 3, 1792651913.0), 'version: two reads at different times must differ'
